title: Geologic map of the Kings Mountain and Grover quadrangles, Cleveland and Gaston Counties, North Carolina, and Cherokee and York Counties, South Carolina
citation: Horton, J.W., 2008, Geologic map of the Kings Mountain and Grover quadrangles, Cleveland and Gaston Counties, North Carolina, and Cherokee and York Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map SIM-2981, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: USGS SIM-2981 pamphlet (Horton, 2008), Kings Mountain and Grover quadrangles, Cleveland and Gaston Counties NC and Cherokee and York Counties SC, 1:24,000. The map straddles the state line and the descriptions do not separate states, so units are recorded for the whole map. Units from the Description of Map Units (pages 14-19): symbol, name, age where printed (Battleground and Blacksburg members take the formations' Neoproterozoic age), and group; descriptions, thicknesses and mineralogy not itemized because the two-column text layer interleaves units. Inner Piedmont symbols printed with a Cambrian sign are OCR'd '_' and flagged inferred. Map sheet (page 20, OCR) and mineral deposits not itemized. SUBSURFACE: none (cross sections on the map sheet not digitized).
